On a dark, stormy winter night, Juha was sitting in his house alone, feeling very cold. The house was devoid of furniture and money, and there was nothing in it except an old, empty wooden wardrobe, and a simple bed.

Suddenly, Juha heard a faint sound coming from the window.

There was a thief sneaking in very carefully to steal the house!
Juha watched the thief from under the covers in the dark. He saw the thief entering the house and beginning to search and inspect every corner, under the bed, behind the doors, and in the kitchen, but he did not find anything of value at all.

The thief was feeling angry and frustrated, so how could he get tired and sneak into a house where he could not find even a loaf of dry bread!
The thief finally approached the large wooden safe in the corner, and said to himself: “Surely this man hides his money and valuables inside this safe.”

The thief opened the closet door carefully.

As soon as he opened it, he was shocked and stepped back in horror!
He found Juha standing inside the closet, curled up on himself, looking at him with a very shy smile in the complete darkness!
The thief stammered, trembling with fear, and said: “A.

A.

What are you doing here in the closet, man, this late? Where is your money and belongings?

Juha came out of the closet very calmly, looked at the thief with a look full of shame and regret, and said in a low voice:
“I beg your pardon, sir thief.

I swear to you, I am very ashamed of you!”

The thief was surprised and asked: “Are you ashamed of me? Why are you ashamed of a thief who came to rob you?”

Juha answered with honesty and funny spontaneity: “I heard you entering my house and getting tired of searching and searching in this bitter cold, hoping to find something of value to steal.

Because my house is completely empty and I am poor and destitute and do not have anything worth stealing, I felt very embarrassed in front of you because I will disappoint you and waste your precious time!”

Juha added: “Therefore, I did not find a place to hide because I was so ashamed of you except this empty closet! So I hope you will forgive me for my negligence in not providing valuable things for you to steal!”

When the thief heard these words, he could not control himself, and burst into continuous hysterical laughter until he almost fell to the ground.

The thief took pity on Juha due to his extreme poverty and simplicity, so he took out of his pocket some coins that he had stolen from another house, and gave them to Juha, saying: “You are the strangest man I have ever met in my life, Juha! Take this money and buy some food and a heater with it, and do not be ashamed of thieves after today!”

Juha took the money while laughing secretly. With his intelligence and wit, he was able to turn an evil thief who came to rob him into a generous donor who gave him money and left in peace, proving that a sense of humor and intelligence can save a person from the most difficult and dangerous situations.
